subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 11: Get ready for… B1 Preliminary
outcomes: Choose the correct word for each gap in a text about green turtles.
Use exam tips for reading, listening and speaking tasks.
Compare activities and give reasons when you speak.

tf.s: Green turtles live on the Great Barrier Reef in Australia.
tf.why: Yes, the text is about turtles on the Great Barrier Reef.

tf.s: A report found that rising temperatures mean 99% of turtles are born female.
tf.why: Correct! Rising temperatures are changing turtle births.

tf.s: In a gap-fill task, you should read only the words next to the gap.
tf.why: First read the whole text, then look at each gap.

tf.s: In Listening Part 1, you should choose the first picture you hear.
tf.why: Listen carefully to the whole recording before you choose.

tf.s: If we don’t stop global warming, green turtles may become extinct.
tf.why: Right! Extinct means no more turtles.

tf.s: In Listening Part 2, you should listen for the speakers’ opinions.
tf.why: Great! The questions ask what the speakers think.

tf.s: In the speaking exam, it is enough to say one word without a reason.
tf.why: Compare the pictures and explain your answer with a reason.

tf.s: In Reading Part 4, the sentence you choose must fit with the sentences before and after the gap.
tf.why: Yes, check the sentences around the gap.

tf.s: “Water skiing is more exciting than mountain biking” compares two activities.
tf.why: More … than is used to compare.

tf.s: The text says global warming is good for green turtles.
tf.why: Global warming is a danger for green turtles.

boxes.q: Green turtles live on the Great Barrier Reef ___ Australia.
Scientists say we ___ do something now to stop global warming.
boxes.why: It is necessary to act now.

boxes.q: A ___ has found that 99% of turtles are born female.
boxes.why: Scientists write a report about what they found.
Extinct means there are none left.

boxes.q: What should you read first in a gap-fill task?
boxes.why: Reading the whole text helps you understand it.

boxes.q: What should you listen for in Listening Part 2?
boxes.why: Part 2 is about what the speakers think.

boxes.q: Water skiing is ___ exciting ___ mountain biking.
What should you do in the speaking compare task?
What percentage of turtles are born female, says the report?

hunt.q: Where is the Great Barrier Reef?
Text type that found the facts
Turtles are in danger ___ of heat

mcq.q: What is the reading tip for the gap-fill task (Reading Part 5)?
o: Read the whole text first, then each gap.
Choose the longest word every time.
mcq.why: Understanding the whole text helps you choose.

mcq.q: What is the tip for Listening Part 1?
o: Don’t choose the first picture you hear; listen to the whole recording.
Choose the first picture you hear.
mcq.why: The first thing you hear is not always the answer.

mcq.q: What do rising temperatures mean for green turtles?
o: Most baby turtles are born female.
mcq.why: The report says 99% are born female.

mcq.q: Where do the green turtles in the text live?
mcq.why: The text is about the Great Barrier Reef in Australia.

mcq.q: Choose the best answer for the speaking task: “Which activity is the most exciting?”
o: I think water skiing is more exciting than mountain biking because you can jump over waves.
mcq.why: A good answer compares and gives a reason.

mcq.q: Answer the question “Have you ever been camping?” in the best way.
o: Yes, I have. I went camping in the desert with my family.
mcq.why: Full answers with details are better in the exam.

mcq.q: Choose the word for the gap: “Green turtles are in danger ___ temperatures are rising.”
Why is it a good idea to read the whole text before choosing answers?
o: To understand what the text is about first
mcq.why: Knowing the main idea helps you choose the right word.

mcq.q: Why may green turtles become extinct?
o: Global warming means almost no male turtles are born.
mcq.why: With so few males, it is hard for turtles to survive.

mcq.q: In Reading Part 4, how can you check that a sentence fits the gap?
o: It must make sense with the sentences before and after.
It must be the shortest sentence.
It must start with the same letter.
mcq.why: The sentences around the gap give you clues.
